name: Wild blue phlox
desc: Wild blue phlox (Phlox divaricata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Phlox divaricata, the wild blue phlox, woodland phlox, or wild sweet william, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polemoniaceae, native to forests and fields in eastern North America.
